text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Tuesday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The president and one of the main owners of troubled Tauras Bank Genadijus Konopliovas, 52, was found dead Monday with a bulet wound in his head. Police suspect suicide.
- President Algirdas Brazauskas gave no definite answer as to whether he will run in the upcoming presidential elections.
- The Lithuanian government said that around 250 thousand workers are employed without necesaary contracts and suggested to impose 10,000 litas fines to emploers for every illegal worker found.
- Williams De Broe will distribute the remaining eight million litas of a Hermis Bank share issue in global depository receipts before August.
- The securities commission registered the share split of state run Savings Bank shares. Every 100 litas face value ordinary share was split into 10 shares with a 10 litas face value each.
- US deputy state secretary Ron Asmus arrive to Vilnius on Tuesday to talk to diplomats about the Lithuania-America charter.
- Lithuanian President Algirdas Brazauskas told a news conference on Monday that the country needs a new generation of politicians which were not tainted by Marxist ideology.

- The Lithuanian government intends to approve in a cabinet meeting on Wednesday the reorganisation Lithuanian Energy company by separating the inefficient heating sector from the company and passing it to the municpalities.
- Direct foreign investments at the beginning of April were 2.775 billion litas, a 488 million litas increase during the first three months of the year.
